fields.description: Collapse key string for the message (optional). This is an identifier for a group of messages that can be collapsed, so that only the last message is sent when delivery can be resumed. A maximum of 4 different collapse keys may be active at a given time.
fields.label: Collapse Key

fields.description: Priority of the message (optional). Must be one of high or normal.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: The time-to-live duration of the message (optional). This can be specified as a numeric seconds value or a datetime.timedelta instance.
fields.label: TTL

fields.description: The package name of the application where the registration tokens must match in order to receive the message (optional).
fields.label: Restricted Package Name

fields.description: contains additional options for features provided by the FCM Android SDK (optional).
fields.label: Analytics Label

fields.description: The name of a sound file in your app's main bundle or in the Library/Sounds folder of your app's container directory. Specify the string default to play the system sound.
fields.label: Sound Name

fields.description: Set the critical alert flag on the sound configuration. Requires Apple's critical-alert entitlement — leave off for ordinary app notifications.
fields.label: Critical

fields.description: The volume for the critical alert's sound. Must be a value between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (full volume) (optional).
fields.label: IOS Notification Sound Volume

fields.description: Kill switch for the daily User Device staleness sweep. Leave unchecked to keep token cleanup running; check it and the scheduled job exits early without inspecting any rows.
fields.label: Disable Token Sweep

fields.description: Hard-delete User Device rows that have been disabled (enabled=0) for at least this many days. The grace period exists so a temporarily-offline device that comes back online doesn't lose its row immediately. Unset falls back to 30.
fields.label: Disabled Token Retention (Days)

fields.description: Soft-disable enabled User Device rows that have been silent (no FCM error feedback, no mobile re-registration) for at least this many days. Mirrors the FCM Flutter doc's recommended staleness window. Disabled rows then enter the retention window above. Unset falls back to 90.
fields.label: Token Staleness Window (Days)

fields.description: Sending from Notification Center is blocked when the rendered title or body matches any row.
fields.label: Blocked Words and Patterns

fields.description: RQ queue for asynchronous Notification Log sends. Leave empty to use notifications_queue when the bench defines it, and the always-present short queue when it does not.
fields.label: Dispatch Queue

fields.description: Push every Desk Notification Log through FCM. Uncheck on a site whose devices belong to customers, so operator Desk alerts are not pushed to them with an unroutable Desk payload. Unset reads as enabled.
fields.label: Push Desk Notification Logs

fields.description: Roles that may read/write/create their OWN User Device rows. Synced to Custom DocPerms on every migrate; empty means only the roles in the DocType itself.
fields.label: Device Owner Roles

fields.description: Extra data-payload keys never truncated by the 4 KB trim, one per line or comma separated. doctype, docname, type, kind, ref, nid, route, spa_route, ticket_id and conversation_id are always preserved.
fields.label: Preserved Payload Keys

fields.description: Hold an asynchronous send until the transaction that created the Notification Log commits. The after_insert hook fires inside that transaction, so without this a rolled-back document can still be pushed. Off keeps the historical behaviour.
fields.label: Enqueue After Commit
